videos.headline: Grier shows off arm with 55-yard TD strike
videos.description: West Virginia's Will Grier has plenty of time to wind up and deliver a perfect 55-yard cannon to Ka'Raun White who scores to put the Mountaineers up 17-0.

videos.headline: Grier and Mountaineers strike first
videos.description: West Virginia's Will Grier finds David Sills V on a slant route for the first-drive score to take an early 7-0 lead.

videos.headline: Mountaineers execute tip drill for interception
videos.description: West Virginia's Al-Rasheed Benton comes down with the deflected pass, and the interception sets up a Mountaineers' field goal.

videos.headline: Iowa State caps first drive of second half with TD pass
videos.description: Cyclones gain momentum in the second half after Allen Lazard uses his body for the goal line touchdown catch.

videos.headline: Iowa State's Allen fully extends for sideline catch
videos.description: Iowas State's Chase Allen reaches all the way back to bring down the Kyle Kempt pass in the red zone setting up a field goal.

videos.headline: Double-coverage not a worry for White
videos.description: Will Grier stands and the pocket and delivers a long throw over the middle and Ka'Raun White comes down with the 33-yard catch between two defenders.

videos.headline: Payne strips ball away from receiver for improbable pick
videos.description: D'Andre Payne gives the Cyclones the ball back after ripping the pass away from David Sills V in the end zone for the interception.

videos.headline: Mountaineers hold on fourth down
videos.description: Up 20-16 with under three minutes left, West Virginia brings the pressure and forces the Iowa State incompletion on fourth down.

videos.headline: Grier goes deep for White early
videos.description: West Virginia's Will Grier buys time in the pocket and throws it deep for Ka'Raun White who appears to score a touchdown but steps out of bounds after a 63-yard gain.

videos.headline: Relentless Mountaineers' defense forces another punt
videos.description: West Virginia's David Long Jr. comes in screaming on a blitz and deflects the pass at the line of scrimmage to force an Iowa State punt.

videos.headline: Crawford shows Le'Veon Bell-like patience
videos.description: West Virginia's Justin Crawford cuts behind his blockers and back across the field for a 21-yard gain.

videos.headline: Iowa State swings momentum with fourth down stop
videos.description: Will Grier was guiding West Virginia steadily down the field, but Iowa State comes up with the big run stuff on fourth down.

videos.headline: Coach Holgorsen challengers Mountaineers to play with "physical nature"
videos.description: Against a tough Iowa State team, West Virginia head coach Dana Holgorsen says his team relied on their physicality with the running game in their 20-16 win.

videos.headline: Timely defensive stops help West Virginia hold off Iowa State
videos.description: The big play eluded the Cyclones' offense while Will Grier was able to establish a balanced attack as West Virginia beats Iowa State 20-16.
